line: Opening titles for an imaginary 1964 spy film: a chase for a stolen key until the shapes lock into the title.
line_cn: 虚构 1964 年间谍片的片头：追一把被偷的钥匙，几何碎片最后拼成片名。

camera.move: Wide on a full credit line, then truck in

camera.serves: a chase; a race; a delivery

camera.move: Hard cut on a brass stab
Graphic match cut (same shape, same position)
Locked single shape on a flat ground
camera.serves: a cold open; a clue; a logo
a catch; a triumph; a stand-off
a split screen; a conspiracy; a team

camera.move: Vertical pan down a column of type
camera.serves: a building; a roster; a countdown

camera.move: Push into a letter until it fills frame
camera.serves: a door; a tunnel; a window

transitions: Match cuts keep circle centres and sizes identical across the cut.
labels: Credits live in the set, never in the subtitle band: one line per location, fully readable at some moment. Credits are fictional roles only, never real people's names.

Subtitles on a narrow paper strip (scissor-cut ends, slightly tilted) bottom-left, a small glyph from the film as bullet, a geometric OFL sans (e.g. League Spartan 600, ~44 px). Light strip on dark scenes, dark strip on light scenes; slides in from the left in ~0.18 s. Hold ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s).
Hold each credit long enough to read alongside a subtitle.
motion: Puppets on twos (12 fps): poses and positions of figures, hands, letters landing, vehicles. Camera, credit slides and grid growth on ones (24 fps): a stepped camera judders.
Run cycles of ~8 drawings, one step per beat, a strong lean, the accent flying back. Walks one step per beat, coats swinging.
Credits slide in along grid lines and stop dead on the beat (short ease-out); letters land with a paper slap.
Stop-time: at a stab the whole picture freezes (background scroll included) for a couple of beats in total silence, then resumes.

native_moves.name: Type is the set
native_moves.does: Each location is one line of credits and that line is its architecture (letters as pillars, words as carriages, a letter as a lock).
native_moves.fits: a conference programme as a city; a menu as a restaurant; team names as a stadium.

native_moves.name: Credits are rhythm
native_moves.does: Credits land on beats; stabs are cuts.
native_moves.fits: a product's features; a festival line-up; an award's nominees.

native_moves.name: Graphic match cuts
native_moves.does: Shape rhymes, the interval shrinking as tension rises.
native_moves.fits: a coin → a planet → a clock; a gear → a wheel → a sun.

native_moves.name: The diagonal grid
native_moves.does: A diagonal cut multiplies into a grid, and the pieces later fly back along it to assemble something.
native_moves.fits: a puzzle solved; a team forming; a logo assembled.

native_moves.name: Silhouette puppets
native_moves.does: Profile cut-outs whose acting is outline and timing.
native_moves.fits: a heist; a courier on a deadline; a detective.

native_moves.name: Stop-time gag
native_moves.does: Freeze on a stab, silence, resume.
native_moves.fits: a near miss; a double take; a price reveal.

native_moves.name: The object of the chase is the title
native_moves.does: What everyone pursues becomes the last thing assembled.
native_moves.fits: a product launch; a book's name; a birthday name.

score.note: 1960s spy big band: brass stabs, surf guitar twang, walking bass, vibraphone
